evidence_scope: Exact-mode validation supporting Results §3.1: with beam pruning disabled (beam=0), does LinearRaccess reproduce the Raccess reference implementation's accessibility values?
conclusion: LinearRaccess (beam=0, exact log-sum-exp) agrees with the Raccess reference to within ~1.6e-6 absolute probability error and near-perfect rank correlation on 300 randomly generated 100nt RNA sequences, confirming exact-mode correctness independent of any specific biological sequence family.
